title.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash：更长链路推理与面向防御的网络安全模型
title.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash: Longer Reasoning Loops and Defensive Cybersecurity

excerpt.zh: Google发布Gemini 3.8 Flash与Flash Cyber，主打低成本长程编程、代理工作流和漏洞修复，同时以受限方式开放网络安全能力。
excerpt.en: Google introduces Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber for lower-cost long-horizon coding, agent workflows, vulnerability discovery, and defensive patching.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: 一次发布，两种部署方向
text.en: One Release, Two Deployment Paths

text.zh: Google公布了Gemini 3.8 Flash和Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber。前者面向更广泛的开发、分析和代理任务，后者则专门服务网络防御。两者共享基础智能，但面向的使用环境不同：Flash强调通用工作效率、速度与成本，Cyber则把漏洞发现和自动修复放在核心位置。根据发布信息，3.8 Flash延续了3.7 Flash的低价定位，初始价格为每百万输入token 0.75美元、每百万输出token 3.75美元。
text.en: Google has introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber. The first targets broader development, analysis, and agent tasks, while the second is designed specifically for cyber defense. They share a foundational intelligence but serve different deployment environments: Flash emphasizes general productivity, speed, and cost, while Cyber focuses on vulnerability discovery and automated repair. Google lists an introductory price for 3.8 Flash of $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens.

text.zh: 核心变化是让模型多做几步
text.en: The Core Change Is More Deliberation

text.zh: 3.8 Flash的主要思路并不是单纯追求一次回答更快，而是在复杂任务上投入更多推理步骤，并反复调用工具。发布方将这种方式描述为长时间运行的代理循环：模型会递归评估结果，再继续改进。这样的设计适合跨文件修改、测试、调试和报告生成等长程工作，但也意味着高努力级别可能消耗更多token。开发者可以降低努力级别来控制开销，也可以继续使用3.7 Flash处理更看重计算效率的任务。
text.en: The central idea behind 3.8 Flash is not simply to answer faster. On difficult tasks, it spends more reasoning steps and calls tools iteratively. Google describes these as long-running agentic loops in which the model evaluates and refines its results. That design fits work such as multi-file changes, testing, debugging, and report generation, but higher effort can also consume more tokens. Developers can reduce the effort level to manage overhead, or continue using 3.7 Flash when computational efficiency matters most.

text.zh: Google称，3.8 Flash在软件工程、代理任务和多步骤专业推理方面较3.7 Flash有明显提升，并在部分基准测试中接近更昂贵的大型模型。材料提到的软件工程、金融代理、法律代理和HLE-Verified结果，意在说明它能够处理不同领域的连续任务。不过，基准成绩主要反映特定测试条件，不能直接等同于所有真实项目中的可靠自主性。实际部署仍需要权限控制、测试门禁和人工复核。
text.en: Google says 3.8 Flash improves on 3.7 Flash in software engineering, agent tasks, and multi-step professional reasoning, approaching more expensive frontier models on some benchmarks. Results cited for software engineering, finance agents, legal agents, and HLE-Verified are meant to show breadth across sequential tasks. Still, benchmark scores reflect particular test conditions and should not be treated as proof of dependable autonomy in every production project. Real deployments still need permission controls, test gates, and human review.

text.zh: Flash Cyber把重点放在防守
text.en: Flash Cyber Puts Defense First

text.zh: Flash Cyber面向可信任的防御者，通过Fairwind Program向政府机构、关键基础设施运营者和软件维护者提供优先访问。Google表示，该模型在CyberGym漏洞发现测试中达到前沿水平，并在覆盖20种编程语言的内部测试中取得超过70%的成功率。在CWE-Bench自动修复测试中，它的pass@1为47.2%，接近材料所列领先模型的47.8%，但成本更低。
text.en: Flash Cyber is offered through the Fairwind Program to trusted defenders, including government authorities, critical-infrastructure operators, and software maintainers. Google says it reaches frontier-level performance on the CyberGym vulnerability-discovery benchmark and exceeds a 70% success rate on an internal test spanning 20 programming languages. On the CWE-Bench patching evaluation, its pass@1 is reported at 47.2%, close to the 47.8% listed for a leading model, while costing less.

text.zh: 发布材料还列举了若干实际使用案例：Chrome团队称其生成的正确漏洞补丁多于更大型商业模型，Wiz报告称它在内部渗透测试基准上拥有更高召回率和更低成本，Google Cloud漏洞研究团队则称其帮助发现了一个关键基础漏洞。这些例子显示，模型价值可能不仅在于指出问题，也在于缩短从定位到修复的循环。但案例来自相关机构自身，外部用户仍需独立验证结果、误报率和修复是否会引入新风险。
text.en: The announcement also cites practical cases. Chrome’s security team says the model produced more correct vulnerability patches than larger commercial models; Wiz reports higher recall and lower cost on an internal penetration-testing benchmark; and Google Cloud’s vulnerability research team says it helped find a critical foundational vulnerability. These examples suggest that the value may lie not only in identifying problems but also in shortening the path from detection to repair. Because the examples come from the organizations involved, other users should independently verify accuracy, false positives, and whether patches introduce new risks.

text.zh: 安全边界与开放问题
text.en: Safety Boundaries and Open Questions

text.zh: 两款模型都配有针对滥用的安全措施，发布信息特别提到化学、生物、放射性、核相关风险和网络攻击风险，以及对提示注入的鲁棒性提升。Cyber的网络安全缓解措施更为宽松，因此没有面向普通用户全面开放，而是限制给可信防御者。这个安排体现出明显取舍：更强的安全分析能力有助于维护者，但同样可能被用于攻击准备。访问审核、日志记录、隔离环境和发布后的持续评估，将决定这种能力能否被负责任地使用。
text.en: Both models include safeguards against misuse. Google specifically mentions chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear risks, cyber offense, and improved robustness against prompt injection. Cyber has a more permissive cybersecurity mitigation profile, so it is restricted to trusted defenders rather than broadly released. This reflects a clear tradeoff: stronger security analysis can help maintainers, but similar capabilities could also support attack preparation. Access review, logging, isolated environments, and continuous post-release evaluation will matter in determining whether the capability is used responsibly.

text.zh: 另一个实际问题是成本结构。3.8 Flash的宣传价格只在2026年12月31日前有效，之后输入和输出价格都将上调。模型在高努力级别下可能使用更多token，因此仅比较单token价格并不足够，还应测量完成任务的总成本、重试次数、人工审查时间和失败后果。对企业而言，最有价值的评估通常不是一次性的演示，而是围绕真实代码库、数据权限和回滚流程进行小范围试运行。
text.en: Cost is another practical issue. The introductory price for 3.8 Flash lasts through December 31, 2026, after which both input and output prices are scheduled to increase. Because higher effort may use more tokens, per-token pricing alone is not enough. Teams should measure total task cost, retries, review time, and the consequences of failure. For enterprises, the most useful evaluation is usually a limited trial against real codebases, access policies, and rollback procedures rather than a one-off demonstration.

text.zh: 结论：适合受控的长期任务
text.en: Conclusion: A Fit for Controlled Long-Horizon Work

text.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash的发布重点，是把更多推理和工具调用投入到长程编程与代理流程中，同时保持相对低的入门价格。Flash Cyber则把同一基础能力收窄到网络防御，并通过受限访问降低滥用风险。若发布方所述性能能够在独立测试和真实环境中复现，这一组合可能对代码维护、安全审计和复杂分析具有吸引力。不过，它更像是需要监督的工程协作者，而不是无需检查的自主执行者。
text.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash is positioned around spending more reasoning and tool-use on long-horizon coding and agent workflows while keeping a relatively low entry price. Flash Cyber narrows related capabilities toward cyber defense and uses restricted access to reduce misuse. If the reported performance holds up in independent evaluations and real environments, the pair could be useful for code maintenance, security review, and complex analysis. For now, however, the models are better understood as supervised engineering collaborators than as autonomous systems that need no checking.
